name: Weft
tagline: One board for every AI you use: agents claim tasks and finish with proof you accept or return
description: Weft is a task board shared by every AI client you use. Cline claims a task with a lease so no other agent duplicates it, reports progress while it works, asks you only what only you can decide, and finishes with a receipt (artifacts you can check and what it did not do) that you accept or send back. Projects, sprints and a 30-day trash are included. Hosted remote server with OAuth sign-in; free plan available.
